## HueMux v0.0.4 — The redesigned Lights screen

> **Stable.** This release brings the full lights-screen redesign: rooms as
> collapsible cards, a white-temperature picker, roundtrip-paced color
> probing, per-lamp-type icons, and the on/off border tint — everything the
> alpha series (v0.0.4-alpha.1 through .18) built and polished against daily
> use on a real bridge.

### Rooms are collapsible cards

Each room renders as one card — archetype icon, name, light count, up to four
color-summary dots, and a chevron that collapses the whole card to its header.
Collapsed state persists per device and survives reloads. The grid columns are
a per-device setting: 1/2/3/4 with a responsive Auto mode (1 below 420px, 2 on
phones, 3–4 on wider surfaces).

### White-temperature picker

The color picker's right edge is a white-temperature gradient (6500 K top,
2000 K bottom) that sets the white point directly in mirek — no conversion
step. White-ambiance-only bulbs get a full-canvas temperature picker, and
every card tints itself from mirek while its light is in CT mode.

### Color probing paces itself to the bridge

Dragging in the picker sends at most one probe at a time; the next pick is
held pending until the bridge's confirmation comes back, and the measured
roundtrip feeds a self-correcting pace. A 1–4s timeout releases the budget
when an event is lost, so the pipeline can slow but never wedge. No more tail
of queued color updates after the finger lifts.

### Lamps show their real type

Cards use the light's own CLIP v2 archetype for their icon: ceiling and
pendant lamps, floor and table lamps, lightstrips and play bars, globes, wall
lamps, and spots — unknown types fall back to the bulb. Rooms get the same
treatment from their archetype.

### State in the borders, color everywhere

An ON light card carries a faint wash of its own color around the ring with
the 6px strip at full strength; an OFF card goes grey all round. The color
button stays tinted with the selected hue either way. Tile and card buttons
are icon-only: no outlines, 26px glyphs, fill carries state. Brightness
sliders paint their fill with the light's color (a gradient of every active
color on the tiles), live while dragging.

### Presets and scenes

Entertainment-zone scenes sit in a wrapping strip at the bottom, each chip
tinted by its first swatch with an HSV-saturated hover pop; favorited stars
take the scene's tint. The filter survives cold starts (localStorage) and
direct bookmarks (`/lights.html?filter=all`).

### Everything else stays

The OLED-black palette, Fira Code, the brightness slider's on/dim/off quirk
rules, favorites, bottom navigation, and the screen-sync half are unchanged.

### Phone corrections folded into this release

- Columns default to **Auto**: 1 per row below 600px, 2 at 600, 3 and 4 at
  the wide breakpoints; fixed 1–4 choices still clamp to one column on
  narrow screens so the card text stays readable.
- The Android app pins its loopback port to **7654** — the previous
  scan-for-a-free-port behavior could land a launch on a different origin
  and silently reset every localStorage preference (collapsed rooms,
  columns, theme, language, filter).
- The room tile's "All in this room" title is back.
- Color changes made from another app re-tint the aggregate tiles' bulb
  icon, color button, and active state live.
